segments.sn26.9:1.2: “Yo kho, bhikkhave, pathavīdhātuyā uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo … pe … jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo;
segments.sn26.9:1.3: yo āpodhātuyā … yo tejodhātuyā … yo vāyodhātuyā … yo ākāsadhātuyā … yo viññāṇadhātuyā uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṃ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
segments.sn26.9:1.8: Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, pathavīdhātuyā nirodho … pe … jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo;
segments.sn26.9:1.9: yo āpodhātuyā nirodho … yo tejodhātuyā nirodho … yo vāyodhātuyā nirodho … yo ākāsadhātuyā nirodho … yo viññāṇadhātuyā nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṃ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo”ti.
